query:
SELECT c.nome, c.apelido, c.empresaSlug, fc.totalServicos, fc.totalProdutos, fc.totalGeral, fc.ultimaSyncEm 
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc 
JOIN colaboradores c ON c.id = fc.colaboradorId 
WHERE fc.mes = 3 AND fc.ano = 2026 
ORDER BY fc.totalGeral DESC 
LIMIT 15;
